newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian wields bazooka in marital dispute.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian wields bazooka in marital dispute.

text.p: From the files of the U.N. police in Sarajevo comes word of a marital dispute on Serb territory, which, in the words of U.N. spokesman Alex Ivanko, "in classic Bosnian style went a little too far."
Pero Toljic and his wife began arguing at their home in the village of Lipovica on November 17. As the altercation escalated the woman fled to a neighbour's house.
"The husband followed her with a bazooka. He then tried to fire the bazooka at his wife, missed, and hit his house, causing damage," Ivanko said.
Toljic was arrested by local Serb police and charged with disturbing the peace and possession of an illegal firearm.
